problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $a=⟨-5,3,0⟩$, $b=⟨2,-1,4⟩$ and $c=⟨1,1,1⟩.$
worked_solution:
The volume of the parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot (b\times c) & =|\begin{aligned}-5 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 & 4 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-5)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}|-3\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 4 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =-5((-1)\cdot 1-1\cdot 4)-3(2\cdot 1-1\cdot 4)+0 \\  & =25+6 \\  & =31\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we take the absolute value. So the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is

$$
V=|31|=31.
$$
